_anonymised_copy: Anonymised copy of a registered protocol file: internal provenance fields (storage ids, hosts, resource accounting, internal review notes) were removed or redacted. Embedded sha256 values refer to the original registered file and do not match this copy.
plan: PAKDD 2027 method paper, robustness track (TKGQA study). Post-hoc robustness evaluation of the FROZEN MultiTQ k% arms; protocol: tkg-claims-protocol.
question: Under meaning-preserving changes of question wording, do the frozen LLM arms of the k% experiment (G_k guided reasoner, P_k LLM parser) lose less MultiTQ test Hits@1 than the structural parser alone (S_k), and how does the unguided LLM (GU_k) behave?
nature: POST-HOC robustness probe of frozen systems. No model, adapter, checkpoint, threshold, prompt, decoding setting or fallback rule is changed, and nothing is selected. Its numbers cannot feed back into any arm and do not change any registered k% outcome (KP1-KP4).
why_test_is_legitimate: Every arm is frozen by sha256 (structural, guided and parser freezes listed below) and its full-test predictions were scored once on 2026-10-28T01:11:37Z (multitq_kpct_test_results.json). This probe re-runs those frozen artefacts on perturbed copies of test questions. Because no choice of any kind is made from probe outputs, using test questions adds no selection bias; it adds descriptive information only. Dev questions are not used.

status_at_registration.probe_outputs: None. No perturbed question, paraphrase, judge verdict, bundle, retrieval, generation or prediction of this probe exists; no probe job has been launched on any host; no Hits value on the sample quids (original or perturbed) has been computed.
status_at_registration.work_before_registration: Read the k% rule, test results, report, the three freezes and the frozen code. Drew the probe sample from the quid and qtype fields of questions/test.json only (recipe below; lists embedded here). Wrote rob_common.py (sampling, deterministic perturbations, the two LLM prompts, mechanical paraphrase checks; sha256 below) and tested the mechanical entity-chunk extractor on the ORIGINAL text of sample questions (no answers, no arm output, no LLM call).
status_at_registration.existing_test_exposure: Full-test Hits@1 of every arm is known to the designers (e.g. RULE_1 0.6831, S_1 0.7234, G_1 0.7992, P_1 0.7598, GU_1 0.6639; RULE_5 0.9126, S_5 0.9175, G_5 0.9350, P_5 0.9396; RULE_100 0.9272, S_100 0.9310, G_100 0.9554, P_100 0.9486, GU_100 0.7146). Dev stress checks (multitq_stress_checks.md) showed RULE/S almost unchanged under the prefix and '?' removal on 1,200 dev questions; the structural tokenizer maps punctuation to spaces, so P2 is expected to be a no-op for RULE/S by construction.

sample.recipe: qtype-stratified, largest-remainder allocation proportional to the test qtype counts; within each qtype (qtypes in sorted order) the quids are sorted ascending and numpy.random.default_rng(20261028).choice(n_qtype, alloc, replace=False) is applied with ONE generator shared across qtypes (rob_common.draw_sample)

p3_subsample.recipe: qtype-stratified largest-remainder allocation over the 2,000-sample qtype counts; default_rng([20261028, 3]).choice within each qtype (sorted quids, sorted qtypes)

perturbations.ORIG: original question text, re-run through the same probe pipeline (reference for every drop)
perturbations.P1_prefix: exactly 'Please answer: ' prepended to the original text (rob_common.p1_prefix); all 2,000
perturbations.P2_qmark: trailing '?' removed where present, after stripping trailing whitespace (rob_common.p2_strip_qmark); all 2,000 (2000 changed, 0 unchanged and kept); P2 is also reported on the changed subset

P3_paraphrase.generator: API LLM generator (GEN_MODEL_ID; model ID reported in the paper), prompt rob_common.GEN_PROMPT, max_tokens 300, provider default temperature, one call per question; returns JSON {paraphrase, kept_verbatim}
P3_paraphrase.attempts: at most 2 per question. Attempt 2 only for questions whose attempt-1 paraphrase failed a mechanical check or the judge; attempt 2 = GEN_PROMPT + GEN_RETRY_SUFFIX showing the rejected attempt-1 text (no judge reasons shown). The first accepted attempt is kept.
P3_paraphrase.mechanical_checks: rob_common.mechanical_check (gold-free): non-empty single line ending in '?'; length <= 2.5x original; not identical to the original after lowercasing and removing punctuation; the original's explicit time expression (frozen regex mtq_lib.parse_time) appears verbatim and parses to the same (level, value), and no time expression is added; every capitalised chunk of the original (rob_common.protected_chunks; maximal runs of capitalised tokens with name connectors, sentence-initial function words dropped) appears verbatim; every kept_verbatim string occurs verbatim in both texts
P3_paraphrase.judge: independent call with a DIFFERENT prompt (rob_common.JUDGE_PROMPT) and an API LLM judge (JUDGE_MODEL_ID; model ID reported in the paper), max_tokens 200; it sees only the original and the paraphrase (no answers, no qtype); returns booleans same_answer_set, same_entities, same_time, same_relation, grammatical
P3_paraphrase.acceptance: accepted iff every mechanical check passes AND all five judge booleans are true. The judge is called only on mechanically valid paraphrases. No arm output is ever consulted for acceptance; accepted paraphrases are never edited.
P3_paraphrase.target: accepted >= 450 of 600; if fewer after attempt 2, P3 proceeds with the accepted set and is labelled P3_UNDER_TARGET (no further generation)
P3_paraphrase.template_flag: for each accepted paraphrase and its original, the masked template key (kpct_keys.py / masked-template definition: frozen v3 linker, mentions -> ENT, time -> timex) and whether it occurs among the train templates of each k list (k01_s0, k05_s0, k100); computed on the remote host from question text only
P3_paraphrase.freeze: the perturbed-question set (all variants, every attempt, mechanical reasons, judge verdicts, model ids, token usage) is written as multitq_robustness_perturbed_set.json with a content sha256 and saved as an artifact BEFORE any arm is run on it

arms.grid: k in {1 (= list k01_s0), 5 (k05_s0), 100 (k100)}; GU only at k = 1 and 100 (GU_5 was never run: NOT_RUN in the k% experiment)
arms.RULE_k: frozen structural executor (executor/models/<k>: linker.json, parser.pt, FB.json) re-run on the variant text: link -> classifier probabilities (one batch over the variant file) -> mtq_cand parse_info -> build_info -> RULE ordering -> padding; same code path as kpct_run.w_infer (k100: frozen v3 artefacts, same path as kpct_k100.py)
arms.S_k: the same pool re-ranked by the frozen S_seed0-2 LightGBM models; per-question hit = mean over the 3 seeds
arms.G_k: frozen guided adapters (G_k01_s0_ordS_s0/ep2, G_k05_s0_ordS_s0/ep2, G_k100_ordS_s0/ep1; sha256 as in the guided freeze), candidate order S, the frozen gk_infer.py (vLLM 0.10.2, greedy, max 48 new tokens, max_model_len 2304) on bundles REBUILT from the variant text by the structural pipeline (parse, top-20 S_k seed-0 candidates, 20 provenance facts, operator trace; kpct_core.bundle_core); ranked list = [answer] + the variant's S_k seed-0 list; validity rule unchanged, no fallback
arms.P_k: frozen parser adapters (P_k01_s0_s0/ep3, P_k05_s0_s0/ep1, P_k100_s0/ep0.5; tau off as frozen), frozen pk_infer.py on the variant text (greedy, max 160 new tokens), frozen pk_execute.py: compact_to_parse with the variant's structural bundle parse, operators + 3 S_k seeds with probs=classifier; fallback unchanged = the variant's own S_k output (invalid JSON, unknown name, empty pool); per-question hit = mean over the 3 seeds
arms.GU_k: frozen GU adapters (GU_k01_s0_s0/ep3, GU_k100_s0/ep1) with their frozen gu_pad.json; facts from the frozen dense retriever (gu_retrieve.py: bge-large-en-v1.5, the frozen fact index gu_retrieval/fact_emb_f16.npy, query prefix unchanged) applied to the variant text; frozen gk_infer.py
arms.integrity: before any generation the job verifies the sha256 of every adapter_model.safetensors against the freezes and of the frozen code files it imports against the frozen code tarballs; a mismatch stops the job (STOP_TEST_INTEGRITY)
arms.synthetic_quids: variants are processed in one file per arm with synthetic quid = 10 * quid + variant index (ORIG 0, P1 1, P2 2, P3 3). No frozen code path uses the quid semantically for these arms (G order S does not use the quid; GU/P read it only as a key); mapped back before scoring

pipeline_identity_checks.I1_structural: ORIG rebuilt RULE and S_seed0-2 lists vs the frozen test prediction files on the 2,000 quids (top-1 and full top-50 list), and rebuilt ORIG bundles vs the frozen test bundles (candidate answers in order, fact ids, parse relations/mentions). Required: top-1 identity >= 99.5% for RULE and each S seed and candidate-list identity >= 99.5% at each k; otherwise STOP_PIPELINE_DRIFT (one logged bug-fix iteration of the probe code, then frozen as is and labelled)
pipeline_identity_checks.I2_llm: ORIG re-run answer of G, GU and P (top-1 of each seed list for P) vs the frozen test predictions on the same quids: agreement rate reported per arm (gold-free); if < 98% the arm is flagged PIPELINE_DRIFT and both drop definitions are shown in the report
pipeline_identity_checks.I3_gu_retrieval: ORIG retrieved fact ids vs frozen gu_test.jsonl.gz on the 2,000 quids (identical top-20 list share)
pipeline_identity_checks.order: I1-I3 are computed from predictions only (no gold) and reported before scoring

metrics.scorer: multitq_eval.hit_at_k (official MultiQA semantics, sha256 above); Hits@1 primary, Hits@10 descriptive
metrics.per_cell: Hits@1 and Hits@10 for every arm x {ORIG, P1, P2, P3} on the variant's quids (P1/P2: 2,000; P3: accepted quids, with ORIG on the same quids), plus FROZEN_ORIG (frozen test predictions on the same quids) as an identity/secondary row
metrics.drop: drop = Hits(ORIG) - Hits(variant) on the same quids, ORIG = the probe re-run (isolates the text change from re-run noise); secondary: FROZEN_ORIG - variant
metrics.flip_counts: lost (ORIG hit, variant miss) and gained, in seed-mean units for S and P; top-1 changed share (gold-free)
metrics.rates: G/GU invalid-answer rate; P invalid rate and fallback rate by reason (invalid_json, unknown_name, empty_pool) per variant
metrics.strata: P3 drop by qtype and by paraphrase-template seen/unseen in the arm's k list (descriptive, B = 1000)

statistic.bootstrap: paired Poisson(1) bootstrap over the variant's questions, B = 2000, seed 0, multitq_eval.paired_poisson_bootstrap (same weights as the k% rule for a given n); two-sided 95% percentile CI; two-sided p = min(1, 2*min(P(boot <= 0), P(boot >= 0)))
statistic.contrast_statistic: for a contrast (L_k - S_k) under a variant vs ORIG the per-question statistic d_i = (L_i,var - S_i,var) - (L_i,ORIG - S_i,ORIG) is bootstrapped with the same weights (paired_poisson_bootstrap(a = L_var - S_var, b = L_ORIG - S_ORIG))
statistic.seeds: S_k and P_k: per-question mean over the 3 S seeds; G, GU: LLM seed 0 (frozen)

criteria.C_R1: at each k in {1, 5, 100}: gap_G = G_k - S_k on P3 and on ORIG (same P3 quids), each with CI, and Delta_G = gap_G(P3) - gap_G(ORIG) with CI
criteria.C_R2: the same for P_k: Delta_P = gap_P(P3) - gap_P(ORIG)
criteria.C_R3: at each k: drop(S_k) - drop(G_k) on P3. Note: algebraically identical to Delta_G of C_R1 (drop(S) - drop(G) = gap_G(P3) - gap_G(ORIG)); reported once, under both names. Also reported for P_k (= Delta_P) and, at k = 1 and 100, drop(S_k) - drop(GU_k)
criteria.secondary: C_R1/C_R2/C_R3 also on P1 and P2 (descriptive); G_k - GU_k gap change at k = 1, 100 (descriptive)
criteria.primary_family: the six P3 contrasts {Delta_G(k), Delta_P(k): k = 1, 5, 100}; Holm correction over these six two-sided p-values

labels.contrast: REPAIRS iff Delta >= +0.01 and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 (the LLM arm loses at least 1 point less than S_k); AMPLIFIES iff Delta <= -0.01 and Holm-adjusted p < 0.05; else NO_DETECTABLE_DIFFERENCE
labels.gap_under_P3: GAP_HOLDS iff the 95% CI of (L_k - S_k) on P3 lies entirely above 0; GAP_LOST iff it lies entirely below 0; else GAP_UNRESOLVED
labels.per_arm_drop: BRITTLE iff drop >= 0.02 and the 95% CI lower bound > 0; ROBUST iff the 95% CI upper bound < 0.02; else INCONCLUSIVE (every arm x variant, unadjusted, descriptive)
labels.justification: 2 points is the size of the LLM-over-structure margin at k = 5 (G_5 - S_5 = +1.75, P_5 - S_5 = +2.21 on full test), so a perturbation drop of >= 2 points is the smallest that would change how the data-efficiency table reads; 1 point is the smallest contrast the paper text would mention and sits below the expected CI half-width at n ~ 450-600 (about 2-3 points), so it binds only together with significance. No overall PASS/FAIL: the probe is descriptive and post-hoc.

selection_discipline: No arm-side choice exists: models, adapters, checkpoints, tau, prompts, decoding, candidate order, retrieval and fallback are the frozen ones. Probe-side choices (sample, perturbations, prompts, attempts, acceptance) are fixed in this file before any probe output. No accepted paraphrase is dropped or edited after arm outputs exist; no question is excluded after scoring. Anything computed later that is not listed here is labelled POST-HOC in the report and is not used for any label.

stop_rules.STOP_BUDGET: no GPU job is launched if measured robustness spend + its projected cost would exceed 5 GPU-h; unrun cells are NOT_RUN
stop_rules.STOP_API: generation and judging stop when the running API estimate reaches USD 4.50; P3 then proceeds with the accepted set (P3_UNDER_TARGET if < 450)
stop_rules.STOP_HOST: Host outages: every stage writes to WORK_DIR/robustness/ and is skipped on resume when its output and sha256 record exist; harvest from the remote directory if a transfer fails. No partial scoring: every planned arm x variant cell must be complete (or declared NOT_RUN with reason) before the single scoring pass. If the host is unavailable past 2026-11-06 UTC, missing cells are NOT_RUN
stop_rules.STOP_GPU_SHARING: before each dispatch check nvidia-smi and docker ps; use only cards with no foreign compute process; one process per card, pinned (--gpus device=N, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, no device_map); never stop another process
stop_rules.STOP_TEST_INTEGRITY: any sha256 mismatch between a probe prediction file and the probe freeze, or between an adapter / frozen code file and its freeze, stops scoring

scoring_discipline: Gold answers are read only by the single scoring pass, which runs after every probe prediction file (all arms x variants) is frozen by sha256 in multitq_robustness_freeze.json and saved as an artifact. The identity checks I1-I3 are computed from predictions only, before scoring.

reporting.wording: API models are 'the API LLM (API LLM)' and 'the API LLM'; every number from a reduced or substituted input is labelled provisional; P3 results describe wording changes with entity names and time expressions kept verbatim -- not entity-surface robustness
